EmailTemplate.subject: Received: Your Intel® Partner Alliance application
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Thank you for applying to the Intel® Partner Alliance Program
Thank you for submitting your Intel Partner Alliance membership request
Depending on whether your request is a new or existing business account, it may take us three business days to review and respond to your request
Once your entitlements have been correctly provisioned, you will receive an email notifying you that you may login to the Partner Portal and experience all the benefits of being an Intel Partner Alliance member
If you do not receive an email after the time listed above, please contact Support
Thank you, Your Intel® Partner Alliance team
This message was sent to you as an important business communication related to your current relationship with Intel® Partner Alliance. © {!Contact.Core_Current_Year__c} Intel Corporation Intel Corporation, 2200 Mission College Blvd., M/S RNB4-145, Santa Clara, CA 95054 USA. www.intel.com Privacy | Cookies
